future_requirement: Candidate and baselines must have the same legal interface unless a difference is explicitly justified and recorded.

if_candidate_has_learned_state_capacity: future baselines receive matched capacity budget
or explicit capacity sweep shows baseline failure is not arbitrary under-capacity

history_policy.if_candidate_receives_feedback_history: baselines must receive the same feedback history through the same serialized interface

query_policy.if_candidate_can_query: baselines must be able to issue legal queries under the same query budget
